RS-Agent SDK (/app/sdk) pitfalls:
- `findNearbyNpc`/`findNearbyLoc`/`findGroundItem` accept regex only — passing a predicate throws `regex.test is not a function`.
- `new BotSDK({...})` config key is `botUsername`, not `username` (wrong key silently connects as "undefined").
- `sdk.sendSetCombatStyle(1)` = Rapid for bows (0=Accurate, 2=Longrange).
- A door listing option `[Open]` is currently CLOSED; `[Close]` means open. Doors auto-close after a while.

- Don't `pkill -f <scriptname>` from Bash — the pattern matches your own compound command and kills your shell (exit 144). Use `ps aux | grep '[x]' | awk` + kill instead.
- Background training scripts (`bun script.ts &`) coexist fine with the MCP `execute_code` connection.
- Death: respawn Lumbridge, keep only 3 most valuable items, everything unequipped; at 8x speed HP can burst-drop between loop iterations, so retreat thresholds must be generous (≥15 of ~40).

# Combat

Successful patterns for combat training.

## Fast HP/damage grinding (Barbarian Village) — proven

Barbarian Village (3082, 3420) barbarians (lvl 7-8, 14 HP, non-aggressive, weak hits) beat Men (7 HP, retarget overhead) and Al-Kharid warriors (multicombat gang-up KILLED the bot with no food). Longhall floor has renewable Cooked meat + Beer spawns (~3077-3080, 3439-3443) — free food.
